unknown: Owner-confirmed hours are unknown / to confirm. The agreeing schedules above are a directory and OpenStreetMap, not the business.
Whether a first-party website exists in 2026 is unknown / to confirm. Brighton Main Streets has no website link. Yellow Pages returned HTTP 403, so an older directory-link claim was not re-read.
Whether John DiPietro, named in the 2017 article, still operates the store is unknown / to confirm.
A current product list, in-store prices, email, and whether the store is cash-only are unknown / to confirm. Loc8NearMe's about text says cash only; OpenStreetMap only records that cash is accepted.
Permission to display the linked photos is unknown / to confirm.
Review text on Loc8NearMe was not copied. Which comments are current is unknown / to confirm.
